title: You're using AI wrong! EP - 03
description:
One thing I've noticed in almost every AI workshop I conduct.

The fear of being left behind is making founders adopt AI before they've identified the problem they're trying to solve.

AI shouldn't be a checkbox or a trend to follow.

The biggest wins usually come from solving small, repetitive bottlenecks first. Once those are removed, teams get back time, decisions happen faster, and people can focus on work that actually creates value.

The goal isn't to use more AI.

It's to use it where it genuinely changes how your business operates.

#shorts #fyp #founderlife #foryou #trendingshorts
